1.consolidated_definition: . Gratis, de balde. (En Andalucía dicen: de valdivia. Y existe este refrán español: “tabaco de valdivia, el pecho alivia”.)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Free of charge, gratuitous. (In Andalusia, they say "de valdivia". There is also this Spanish proverb: "Valdivia tobacco relieves the chest.")
